assumptions: The reflection and planet implementations, chamber operation, frost treatment, and Argo cue method require department review.
This breakdown records scene requirements only and does not constitute safety approval.
breakdown_scope: Scene-level production requirements for S01, traceable to the approved preproduction artifacts.

items.source_basis: Ninel is the sole on-screen performer and moves from a deliberate first breath through a rapid sit-up, reflection test, question, and turn toward the slit.
items.requirement: Maintain repeatable restrained performance timing for the inhale on seven, chamber rise, reflection eyeline, dialogue pause, and final turn.
items.continuity_reset: Log breath, body, head, eyeline, right-hand, and turn marks and restore each shot's starting pose.
assumptions: Movement and capture methods remain subject to performer comfort and qualified review.

items.source_basis: The source limits the compact bay to one chamber, one black monitor, and one narrow observation slit; blocking fixes their relationship around Ninel.
items.requirement: Provide established compact geography with room for seated action, a visible turn, the monitor relationship, and controlled slit reveal.
items.continuity_reset: Document chamber, monitor, slit, and performer marks and restore their visible alignment for every setup and pass.
assumptions: The set can accommodate the planned turn and compact camera paths without moving established elements.

items.source_basis: S01-SH001 and S01-SH002 require a slow dolly-out and hold; S01-SH003 is static; S01-SH004 requires a synchronized arc.
items.requirement: Execute repeatable translation, locked monitor coverage, and the final arc while preserving framing, eyelines, clean passes, and quiet sound states.
items.continuity_reset: Record start/end framing, height, lens, timing, and support marks and return camera support to the exact start state.
assumptions: Final support choice and available operating clearance are unconfirmed.

items.source_basis: Emergency light pulses throughout; planet light grows behind Ninel during Argo's pause and accompanies S01-SH004.
items.requirement: Provide repeatable emergency pulses and a restrained planet-light cue synchronized to Ninel's turn, camera arc, and final line.
items.continuity_reset: Restore and log pulse state, reveal cue start, growth, and final relationship for every take and clean pass.
assumptions: Source placement, color treatment, control, power, and rigging are unconfirmed.

items.source_basis: The countdown reaches seven on the inhale; the scene also needs chamber release, room states, Argo/Ninel dialogue, a held pause, and rotation groan.
items.requirement: Preserve restrained dialogue, breath, repeatable cue timing, isolated actions, and matched room states without acoustically confirming the anomaly.
items.continuity_reset: Log countdown, inhale, release, hum, dialogue, pause, and rotation relationships; restore practical noise and room state.
assumptions: Argo cue method and practical-noise controllability are unconfirmed pending a survey.

items.source_basis: Frost moves on chamber glass before Ninel's first inhale and its pattern must match the wider angle.
items.requirement: Create a visible, repeatable frost state and movement cue that is performer-safe and compatible with clean imagery.
items.continuity_reset: Photograph the approved pattern and restore coverage, movement start, glass clarity, and cue state.
assumptions: Physical treatment and movement method require effects, camera, art, and safety review.

items.source_basis: S01-SH002 and S01-SH003 require the monitor reflection to delay and clear while remaining unresolved and require clean passes.
items.requirement: Deliver the delayed reflection and clearing monitor without confirming whether the anomaly is objective, using matched performance and clean plates.
items.continuity_reset: Restore camera, monitor, lighting, head-angle, eyeline, and performance states for every effect and clean pass.
assumptions: The approved shot list assigns the reflection to postproduction; the method remains unconfirmed.

items.source_basis: S01-SH004 ends with a blue-green planet at a precise mark behind Ninel through the narrow slit before Argo says failure.
items.requirement: Provide a camera-readable planet reveal through the slit with geometry and timing coordinated to the arc, light, pause, and final word.
items.continuity_reset: Log slit geometry, camera endpoint, performer mark, planet position, reveal timing, and clean-plate state.
assumptions: Planet implementation and required plate strategy are unconfirmed.

items.source_basis: Ninel begins inside a sealed chamber, sits quickly, moves to its edge, and turns while camera support operates in the compact set.
items.requirement: Qualified departments review performer access, chamber and glass treatment, seated stability, turn clearance, and camera-path separation.
items.continuity_reset: Recheck access, contact surfaces, chamber state, performer/camera paths, and agreed stop conditions before each take.
assumptions: No chamber mechanism, glass treatment, or support method is safety-approved by this breakdown.

items.source_basis: The reflection is assigned to postproduction while the package does not establish how the planet appears through the slit.
items.requirement: Confirm planet implementation and the reflection/planet plate strategy so camera, lighting, art, sound, and VFX can lock shared requirements.
items.continuity_reset: Until resolved, preserve and log clean monitor, slit, lighting, camera, and performer states.
assumptions: The decision must preserve Ninel's incomplete point of view and the reflection's ambiguity.
